# Qwen4 expected in November

Sources close to the project say Qwen4 could be released in November. The team has not confirmed this and declined to comment when asked.

According to the same sources, the model will come in several sizes, with the largest at around 400 billion parameters. These numbers have not been confirmed by the team and should be treated as rumour.

In the past the Qwen team has announced releases on its own blog a few days before the weights appear. Readers who want to know the moment it happens should watch that blog.

We will update this article if the team confirms or denies any of this. For now, Qwen4 is not released and there is no official date.
